changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.comment: Widen ck_mod_action_action with the owncast.hide/kill/restore verbs (+ the missing federation.finding-resolve — API-DB CHECK parity fix).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE mod_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_mod_action_action

ALTER TABLE mod_action ADD CONSTRAINT ck_mod_action_action CHECK (action IN ( 'matrix.block-user', 'matrix.block-instance', 'mastodon.block-user', 'mastodon.block-instance', 'federation.refer', 'federation.recommend', 'federation.finding-resolve', 'access.suspend', 'access.restore', 'domain.lock', 'domain.unlock', 'wiki.grant', 'wiki.timeout', 'wiki.ban', 'wiki.restore', 'owncast.hide', 'owncast.kill', 'owncast.restore'))
